releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.14
releases.body:
Easier setup on every platform: a guided setup, a faster route to Android from a computer, and a one-click bug report.

## New

- **Send to my phone** (desktop launcher, or `b3_win.py phone`): a computer that has already set the game up builds the Android version itself, then copies it over USB. It installs the app, copies the game data and hands over the game. This takes a few minutes instead of 30 to 60 minutes of setup on the phone. You need USB debugging on. Some phones (vivo, Xiaomi) ask you to confirm the install on the screen, so keep the phone unlocked.
- **Setup guide** (desktop): the first setup is now a step-by-step window. It says how to extract your own copy with your emulator, finds extractions on the computer and checks each one: is it update 1.2.0, are ExeFS and RomFS both present, is the RomFS complete. Start setup is enabled only for a good one. The recomp does not decrypt anything: you extract the files from your own copy with your emulator.
- **Report a bug** (desktop and Android): makes the report zip and opens a new GitHub issue with the version, system and GPU filled in. Attach the zip and describe the problem.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.13
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **The title screen's models turned white after leaving stage select** (#6). The title's new lighting cube map has
  the same address, format and size as the stage-select one, so it shared that GPU image and was never read from
  game memory again: the title was lit with stage-select's lighting. A texture that takes over a shared image now
  reads it again. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_SHARE_REUPLOAD=0` in `config.txt` restores the old behaviour, for comparison.
- **Grass, bushes and leaves drawn as solid light-green blocks** (#7, e.g. at the start of Chapter 4). Foliage is
  drawn in two passes: a depth pass that discards the cards' transparent texels, then a colour pass that only draws
  where the depth is EQUAL. That EQUAL was run as LESS_OR_EQUAL (a workaround for a precision problem on Metal),
  so the colour pass also drew every transparent texel. EQUAL now stays EQUAL, as on the console, everywhere but
  Apple. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_EQUAL_AS_LEQUAL=1` restores the old behaviour. If you see new black edges or missing surfaces, please open an
  issue with a bug report.

## Coming from v0.3.12

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.12
releases.body:
## New

- **Controller rumble on Android.** The game's vibration now reaches the controller you play with, as it already
  did on Windows and Linux. On Android 12 or later, a controller with two motors gets the left and right strengths
  separately; older versions use a single motor. The phone itself never vibrates. `NX_RUMBLE=0` in `config.txt`
  turns it off.
  - Checked that it builds and runs on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 phone; it has not been felt on a real controller yet.
    If your controller does not rumble, please open an issue with `nx.log` (look for the `rumble:` line).
- **The game follows your system language.** New installs default to "Same as the system" (desktop launcher) /
  "System language" (Android): the game's text matches the language Windows, Linux or the phone is set to, with
  regional variants (Traditional Chinese for Taiwan and Hong Kong, Latin American Spanish, UK English). A language
  the game has no text in falls back to English (US). If you already picked a language, it stays as it is.
- **Screenshots.** F12 (on Linux / Steam Deck also a controller's Share/Capture button) saves the game picture

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.11
releases.body:
## Android: a workaround for the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (Adreno 750) crash at startup

- **On phones with an Adreno 750 GPU, the game could close while the title screen loaded** (issue #5). The v0.3.10
  crash report showed the crash is inside Qualcomm's own shader compiler (`libllvm-qgl.so`), in its 512.762 driver
  series. Other projects see the same driver crash on one GPU instruction, the subgroup shuffle, which about a
  quarter of this game's shaders use.
  - On an Adreno 750, or any Qualcomm GPU with a 512.762 driver, those shaders now use an equivalent instruction
    (shuffle-xor) that the driver compiles. The result is the same; other GPUs are not affected.
  - Checked with the rewrite forced on: Windows and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740) phone show the same picture as
    without it. It has not yet been run on an Adreno 750: if you have one, please report whether the game now starts.
  - `NX_SHUFFLE_XOR=0` in `config.txt` turns it off, `=1` forces it on.

Windows and Linux builds are unchanged in behaviour.

## Coming from v0.3.10

- Android: install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.10
releases.body:
## Android: clearer crash reports

- When the game crashes on Android, `nx.log` now names the thread that crashed and where the crash happened (the
  library and offset, such as the game's own library or the GPU driver), with a short backtrace. Before, a crash
  outside the game's own threads left only a fault address, which could not show whether the cause was ours or the
  phone's (issue #5).
- Nothing else changes. If your game crashed on Android, please update and attach the new `nx.log` to your issue.

Windows and Linux builds are unchanged in behaviour.

## Coming from v0.3.9

- Android: install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.
- Windows / Linux / Steam Deck: no need to update.

releases.body:
## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

releases.name: v0.2.5: Fix continuous phantom dodge/evade & SixAxis decouple
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.5

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras

- **Continuous Phantom Dodge/Evade Fixed / Corrección de esquiva/dash continuo fantasma (Fixes #13, #15, #18):**
  - **IHidServer IsSixAxisSensorAtRest (cmd 82):** Implemented Horizon OS nn::hid::IHidServer command 82, returning isAtRest = true. Previously, unhandled command 82 returned false, tricking the game into detecting constant controller movement and triggering endless motion-controlled evades/dashes.
  - **SixAxis Angular Velocity Decoupling:** Restricted right-stick gyro motion aiming simulation exclusively to Persona 5 Royal (Darts minigame). In NieR, the right stick controls the camera; feeding stick inputs into the virtual gyro was generating violent angular velocity spikes that triggered unwanted evade maneuvers when looking around.
  - **Versión oficial v0.2.5 (versionCode 7):** Se corrigió la esquiva automática e incontrolable del personaje al implementar el comando IPC IsSixAxisSensorAtRest y desacoplar la simulación giroscópica del stick derecho de la cámara.

# Alpha Test — versão 0.1 (primeiro APK do projeto)

**Este é o primeiro APK do projeto e o projeto está em fase de desenvolvimento.**

Já é possível jogar os **2 primeiros capítulos**, que foram testados.

releases.name: 3.0.6 - November 18, 2026
releases.body:
* Fixed GB, GBC and GBA games running slow on PAL (576i) 50Hz output
* Fixed JIT IRQ latency bug causing graphical artifacts
* **Restored the original controls of the games with special Wii controls** (Zelda, Mario, Metroid, Ninja Turtles, Mortal Kombat, Star Wars, Harry Potter, Medal of Honor, Boktai, The Lord of the Rings, Castlevania and the rest). The input refactor had rewritten them as a single layout for every controller, which lost things like the Nunchuk's C fast-forward and the D-pad items in the Zelda games, the D-pad punches and kicks in Mortal Kombat, and shoot and jump on A and B in the Metroid games. Each game reads the Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller and GameCube pad as it originally did, through a compatibility layer (legacyinput.cpp), and the Wii U Pro Controller and GamePad play as a Classic Controller everywhere, including the games that only read the Classic Controller on its own

releases.name: 3.0.5 - November 3, 2026
releases.body:
* **The left analog stick now moves the pointer in the menus**, on every controller, like a mouse. It no longer also steps through the buttons; the D-pad still does
* **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.
* **Redesigned Saves screen.** The Save, Load and Delete buttons are now a single **Saves** button. Snapshots fill a grid, with the game's **Cartridge Save** (shown only for games that have one) in its own card beneath. Choosing a card opens a small popover of what can be done with it; the save file's backups are listed from its popover. The Auto Load, Auto Save and Append Auto settings are replaced by a single **Save Mode**: **Snapshot** (the default), **Cartridge Save**, or **Manual**.

releases.name: 3.0.4 - October 20, 2026

* **New menu look!** The menus have been rebuilt with a fresh, modern style: a deeper purple header and footer, cleaner rounded buttons with soft shadows, a redesigned game list with a slimmer scrollbar and a clear highlight on the selected entry, new prompt windows, and more. ## BioShock 1 Native Android ReComp — v0.0.7.9 Experimental

### Highlights & Fixes

- **Fixed Missing Initial Lighting / Pitch-Black Areas on Boot (No Longer Requires Tapping `RES`)**
  - Fixed Xenos `DI_PT_RECTLIST` clear redirection in `PrimaryColorTargetAt()` / `PrimaryDepthTargetAt()` so direct `msaa=0` clears are never stolen by wider targets sharing the same EDRAM base (`0x5a0` / `0x5b0`), and 4x-MSAA fast-clear aliases (`msaa=2`) only redirect to exact `pitch * 2` non-MSAA targets (`640→1280`, `280→560`, `80→160`).
  - Eliminated the giant solid-black tilted shadow-projector boxes caused by uncleared `0.0` dynamic shadow depth targets.
  - Initialized newly allocated `GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8` depth targets and resolved depth surfaces to `1.0` (`ClearDepthTextureOne`) so fresh targets never read `0.0` or recycled VRAM garbage across boot, level loads, or live resolution switches.
  - Armed physical write watches on resolved surfaces, added periodic eviction of dead menu/loading-screen resolved targets (300+ idle frames), and rejected compressed DXT/BC texture fetches from matching stale resolved targets.

## BioShock 1 Native Android Port — v0.0.7.6 (Experimental)

A major **GPU + CPU performance** and **visual accuracy** update for the custom GLES 3.2 Xenos renderer, verified live on Samsung Galaxy A36 (Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 / Adreno 710):
- **Heavy flowing-water corridor:** **21–22 FPS → 46+ FPS** at 540p (`+109%`), **43+ FPS** at native 720p
- **Interiors & Medical Pavilion hallways:** **73–96 FPS** at 360p/540p

---

releases.name: v2.5.17 — Microsoft sign-in
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Microsoft sign-in no longer opens a blank white page** ([#3](https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/issues/3)). Android's WebView puts `; wv` in its user agent, Microsoft reads that as an embedded browser and refuses the page — and what you get is not a message, it is an empty white screen. The marker is gone from the user agent now.

  Two more things the sign-in page needs were missing: cross-site cookies, which `login.live.com` relies on, and a `WebChromeClient`, without which the popups and dialogs the flow opens are silently dropped. The iOS build never hit any of this because WKWebView reports itself as Safari and handles those by default.
- **A sign-in page that fails to load now says why.** Main-frame errors were going nowhere, so a failure left the same white screen with nothing to report.

releases.name: v2.5.16 — Minecraft 26.4 snapshots
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 snapshots start.** A version id like `26.4-snapshot-3` splits into `26` and `4-snapshot-3`, and reading that second part as a plain integer gave nothing — so 26.4 was treated as 26.0, missed the SDL and LWJGL 3.4.3 stack, and launched on LWJGL 3.3.6 instead. The game died immediately with `NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/sdl/SDLPlatform`; the cacio lines in the crash report were a consequence, not the cause. Version numbers are now read digit by digit, so snapshot, pre-release and rc suffixes no longer hide them, and five tests cover the shapes.
- Carries the previous fix as well: on Java 24 and newer the cacio java agent is skipped, because the `sun.misc.Unsafe` calls its `premain` depends on are refused there and a failing agent takes the VM with it.

releases.name: v2.5.15 — Minecraft 26.4 starts again
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 (and anything else on Java 24 or newer) starts again.** The cacio setup loaded a java agent whose `premain` overwrites the AWT toolkit's static fields through `sun.misc.Unsafe` (`staticFieldBase`, `staticFieldOffset`, `putObject`). Those methods are refused from JDK 24 and gone in 26, and a failing agent takes the whole VM down with it — which surfaced as a cacio error at startup.

  The iOS build has always run the same cacio jars without that agent, on the same Java 25, using only `-Dawt.toolkit` and `-Xbootclasspath/a`. Android now does the same on Java 24+ and keeps the agent only for the older runtimes that still need it.

## Lemon-Project v1.6.0

A round of fixes from your logs and reports, plus three things you asked for: a Nintendo button layout for physical controllers, frontends that bring a game's update and DLC along, and the Immediate GPU fences back as an option for advanced users.

# Hokkaido 0.6.4

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB), both on Android 17.

  - Closing a game while its shaders load no longer hangs, and the next launch works.

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.2 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Restores compatibility with third-party native mods. If mods failed to load, or loaded and then force-closed the game, this is the fix.

### Fixed

* **Mods failed to load with "Unknown mod load failure".** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  Adding the companion's slot I/II buttons pushed `BTN_R` to `1 << 8` and widened `daAlink_c::itemTriggerCheck` / `itemButtonCheck` from `u8` to `u16`. That changes the mangled names, so mods built against upstream Dusklight could not resolve them and failed at `dlopen`. The upstream symbols are re-exported as forwarders that translate the button numbering as well as the width — upstream's `BTN_B` is `BTN_S2` here, so widening alone would have routed a sword check to a slot button.

  Measured against three mods: only 2 of 842, 762 and 55 game-symbol imports were unresolved.

* **The game force-closed when a loaded mod ran.**

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.1 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Patch release for **Dual-Screen 3.0**. No gameplay or dual-screen changes — the native code is identical to 3.0.

### Fixed

* **Cosmetics, Luau Support and Randomizer were missing from the Android build.** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  The Android CMake presets listed only the `dusklight` target, so the `dusklight_mods` aggregate target never ran and `bundled_mods/` was never produced. Gradle packs that directory into `assets/mods`, so the APK shipped with no bundled mod packages at all. Mods that depend on the Luau runtime could not load either.

  All three packages are now present: `cosmetics`, `luau_runtime` and `randomizer`.

  CI was never affected — `build.yml` builds `dusklight_mods` as its own explicit `--target` step. This only broke preset-driven local builds.

  monsters that toss their food into the mouth (Lizzie, Ralph, Leon, Rojo, Wally, Edwin and the others on their
  skeleton) throw people up and into their mouths again.
- Picking up an upgrade says UPGRADE. Taken while a challenge's banner was still up, it showed a red RAMPAGE.
- The singer with the guitar in Las Vegas is heard again after the first time through his song. It went quiet for
  good; as in the original, it starts over when you come back near him.

releases.name: RampageRE v1.2.3
releases.body:
RampageRE v1.2.3

The keyboard's controls, and keys that left the game.

- In a game started from the menus, the number keys, N, M, G and Page Up / Page Down no longer change the city, the
  time of day, the monster or the block. They are the developer build's city viewer keys and had stayed on in the
  game, where a stray press threw you out of the level you were playing.
- The README now lists the keyboard's controls. On the keyboard you punch with J, kick with K and grab with L (Space
  jumps, R roars, W A S D move, the arrows turn the head, P, Enter or Esc pause); a controller plays too.

Thanks to the player who reported it.

jjmhalew-rampagere.latest_body:
RampageRE v1.2.8

The order of a frame, the monsters' moves and the bot partner, checked frame by frame against the original game.

- A frame runs in the original's order: every monster picks its next move first, then the monsters move, then the
  people, the traffic and the buildings, then the monsters' blows on each other. A kick on the bot partner now
  lands on the same frame as in the original, and its reaction starts a frame sooner.
- A move that blends into the next one keeps the old move going for 2 more frames before the new one takes over,
  as in the original. Its animation starts at once, as before; a press during those 2 frames picks from the old
  move, as the original does.
- The monster turns towards the stick one frame later, as in the original. Walks and turns now follow the original's
  path.
- A monster walking or knocked into a building front is held off it before it picks its next move. It used to end
  up inside the front for a frame.
- A walk that turns into a punch stops where it is, and a punch that ends in the idle pose no longer slides the
  monster back a little. The idle after a punch now stands where the original's does.

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:
## 升级须知

> [!CAUTION]
> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。
> 直接升级将导致旧备份永远保留在设备上。
> 卸载会清除应用数据和旧备份，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。

- **旧备份不能带到 0.3.0。** 如果还要用旧备份里的存档，请在升级前先恢复。
- 电脑端的旧备份不再显示，也不会自动清理，可以点备份页的“打开文件夹”手动删除。电脑端的备份开关和保留份数会恢复默认。
- 电脑端和移动端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **传输时可以删除目标多出的文件。** 目标有来源没有的文件时，传输页会出现“保留/删除”开关。
- **备份可以直接管理。** 两端的备份都改成文件夹，按 `游戏名/UTC 时间` 存放。移动端放在 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/`，可以用能访问该目录的文件管理器查看和删除；电脑端可以从备份页打开文件夹。
- **备份页可以删除单份备份。** 备份页还会显示实际文件数和不完整备份的占用，并可以清理不完整的备份。
- **适配平板。** 屏幕最短边不小于 600dp 的设备支持横竖屏，主导航移到左上角，内容限制最大宽度，游戏列表按宽度增加列数。手机固定竖屏。
- **两端互看传输进度和结果。** 无论从哪一端发起，两端都能看到进度和逐项结果，也可以取消传输。每个游戏都能查看最近的传输。
- **写入中断提示。** 写入途中应用被关闭时，下次打开会提示文件可能不完整；有备份时可以直接跳到备份。
- **目录失效提示。** 目录被改名或授权失效时，游戏设置页的目录行会显示警告并提供“重新选择”。
- **开屏动画从后台返回时也会播放。** 回到桌面或切换应用后再打开都会播放。为了不闪过离开前的页面，Android 13 及以上的最近任务不再显示页面缩略图。

## 改进

- **移除游戏时会一并删除这个游戏的备份。**
- 启动时进入设备页；从后台返回时留在原页。
- 两端统一返回规则：返回到进入当前页之前的页面；传输详情返回游戏页。Android 返回键逐级返回，最后退出。
- 两端分别统一动效。移动端切页改成两页一起整屏平移，按钮和列表项使用相同的按下反馈；电脑端的列表项和卡片使用相同的悬停和按下效果。
- 移动端页面铺满系统栏，状态栏和页面背景连成一片，弹层遮罩也能盖住状态栏。
- 错误提示尽量写明出错的是电脑还是移动端。
- 比较结果过期后不再报错，会显示黄色提示并自动重新比较，确认后才开始传输。

releases.name: 0.2.0 UI Refactor

## 升级须知

- **Android 需要先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.2.0 起安装包改用固定发布密钥，无法覆盖安装 0.1.0、0.1.1。卸载会清除应用数据，需要重新添加游戏、关联设备并授权目录。
- 电脑端和手机端需要一起升级。
- Windows 只提供免安装版，未做代码签名，首次运行时可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。

## 新功能

- **双端界面重做。** 设备、游戏、任务、传输、备份和设置页换成同一套布局与视觉。各页面分离主次信息。
- **加入 i18n 支持。** 简中、繁中、英语、日语，默认跟随系统，也可以固定一种；Android 的通知会使用所选语言。
- **手动切换主题。** 跟随系统、浅色、深色，保存在本机。
- **备份份数可调。** 默认保留 3 份，可在 1 到 10 之间调整；每个游戏可以跟随全局，也可以单独设置。
- **Android 开屏动画。** 希望各位喜欢~

## 改进

- 手机传输页重新设计，高亮展示两端文件差异，按新增、减少、覆盖、保留等着色。
- 同步计划页顶部汇总文件操作数量，下方明细分组列出文件。
- 传输详情改成进度环加五步进度条，以及详细信息。
- 游戏设置页关联设备显示更直观了。
- 设置页重新设计 UI，更耐看了。
- 备份页显示当前策略和每次备份的时间线。

## 修复

- 修复自动备份存档时，只备份当次传输所变更的文件的问题。
- 修复清除系统浏览器数据可能造成应用数据丢失的问题（手机端的配置改到 Android 原生存储）。
- 修正文字选择、设备地址显示和启动失败时的提示。
- 修复路径显示分行的分割点。
- 修复不能覆盖安装更新 App 的问题（发布工作流使用固定密钥构建 APK）。

---

## Upgrade Notes

- **On Android, you must uninstall the old version before installing.** Starting with 0.2.0, the installer uses a fixed release key, so it cannot be installed over 0.1.0 or 0.1.1. Uninstalling will clear app data, so you will need to re-add games, link devices, and authorize directories.
- Desktop and mobile must be upgraded together.

lambholl-galgame-savedata-sync.latest_body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.body:
# Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows antivirus fix

### **Windows only.** 

Linux, macOS and Android stay on
[1.0.9](https://github.com/SSunnKing/Open-Nectar---Pikmin-Native-PC-Mobile-Port/releases/tag/1.0.9).
Download those from there. Nothing changes in the games themselves.

**Updating:** press **Update** in your launcher. Saves, settings and texture
packs carry over.

## Windows Defender flagged the launcher as a trojan

Some players got a "Threat found" warning from Windows Defender for
`nectar-launcher.exe` (`Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml`). This was a false
positive. The `!ml` means it came from Defender's machine-learning guess,
not from a real malware match.

The launcher was doing things that look suspicious to an antivirus: it
started `curl.exe` and `tar.exe` in the background to download updates and
texture packs, and the exe had no publisher or version info. This release
changes that:

* Downloads now happen inside the launcher instead of through `curl.exe`.
* Update zips are unpacked inside the launcher instead of through `tar.exe`.
* `nectar.exe`, `nectar-pal.exe` and `nectar-launcher.exe` now have
  publisher and version information (right-click → Properties → Details).

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.5-dev
releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.5-dev (versionCode 9).

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.
- Added Optimal (ARM64) and Exact (x86) execution modes. Exact selects the original recompiled algorithms; both modes run as ARM64 code.
- Reduced GLES state traffic between threads, draw preparation work and shader constant uploads, and improved shader program caching.
- Improved launcher operation progress, diagnostics and Play button feedback, with the amber UT3 palette.
- Added an optional 4 GB guest address space, enabled by default on 64-bit devices with at least 5 GiB of RAM.
- Fixed fingerprint sensors being mistaken for gamepads.
- Reduced APK size by stripping non-runtime library symbols while retaining the original library for offline profiling. Expanded regression tests and updated documentation.

### Requirements

Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4.1-dev (versionCode 8).

### Changes

- Improved CPU performance on PhysX Mod Pack maps with native fluid collision kernels, native pair removal and optimized x87 calculations.
- Added on-device HLSL compilation through vkd3d-shader, with shader caching and improved MojoShader compatibility for mod materials.
- Fixed touch aiming: holding Fire no longer blocks another finger's camera movement; dragging from Fire, secondary fire, Jump or Crouch also turns the camera.
- Made the crash monitor a launcher option, disabled by default, to avoid keeping its extra Android process running unless needed.
- Removed FSR3 frame generation. FSR1 spatial upscaling and FXAA remain available.
- Reduced per-draw post-processing overhead and removed temporary qa-flags performance switches.
- Updated localized PhysX and audio setting descriptions.

### Installation and validation

Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4-dev.

### Changes

- Added an FPS counter with a frame-time graph and optional system information for every renderer.
- Added FSR1, FXAA, and FSR3.1 frame generation (DXVK, Android 12+; disabled by default).
- Added CPU-based PhysX effects and OpenAL Soft audio through AAudio with EAX 1–5 support.
- Added a maximum-graphics button and fixed persistence of the 3D rendering scale.
- Fixed terrain rendering in OpenGL ES, accelerated DXT decoding, and allowed unused texture mip levels to stream out.
- Improved GPU query handling in GLES and DXVK, including on PowerVR devices.
- Fixed ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion on shared storage on Pixel devices.
- Added a “Firing or aiming” gyroscope mode and persistent crash reports with a separate error window.

### Installation and limitations

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; frame generation requires Android 12+. Frame generation may cause HUD artifacts and adds GPU and memory overhead. A stable 60 FPS at maximum graphics settings is not guaranteed.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.3-dev
releases.body:
The third release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 improves GLES performance, text editing and graphics cache handling.

### Changes

- Added a dedicated GLES render thread with automatic CPU core selection. Streamed draw uploads, asynchronous query polling and shader program prelinking reduce work on the game thread.
- Added driver-aware graphics cache maintenance: GLES program binaries are invalidated after driver changes, and DXVK keeps the current and newest other pipeline cache for each driver.
- Fixed DXVK scaled vertex formats with a shader fallback for drivers that need it.
- Replaced keyboard-only text entry with an Android editing dialog for game fields, console commands and chat. Existing text can be corrected or cleared; cancellation preserves it, and original character filters remain in effect.
- Added separate weapon-button swipe settings and expanded the in-game Android settings to nine languages: English, Russian, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian and Polish.
- Improved launcher texture status and fixed texture handling, audio and FSINCOS translation. Expanded regression tests and rendering diagnostics.

releases.body:
**Mali Vulkan compatibility.** This release adds a fixed-descriptor rendering path for drivers that lack the features required by the bindless path. It targets startup failures such as those reported on the Infinix HOT 40 with Mali-G52.

## 中文

本期新增 termux-ui 模块，为 Windows 应用、Linux 桌面、文件和运行组件提供统一图形界面。

- Windows 应用与游戏：通过独立的 Wine 环境导入、配置、管理和运行程序。
- Linux 桌面：创建、启动、管理和重新安装 Native 与 PRoot 桌面环境。
- 运行组件：下载和管理 Wine、Box64、图形及配套组件，支持自定义 Wine 和 Box64 版本。
- 文件管理：浏览文件、批量操作、查看文件信息，并将检测到的 Windows 程序导入程序库。
- 输入与显示：按程序配置显示设置、键盘鼠标输入、虚拟按键和游戏手柄。
- 备份与恢复：导出和恢复 PRoot 桌面容器、Wine 环境及 Wine C 盘。

## English

Introduce the new termux-ui module with a unified graphical interface for Windows applications, Linux desktops, files, and runtime components.

- Windows apps and games: import, configure, manage, and launch programs with dedicated Wine environments.
- Linux desktops: create, launch, manage, and reinstall Native and PRoot desktop environments.
- Runtime components: download and manage Wine, Box64, graphics, and supporting components, including custom Wine and Box64 builds.
- File management: browse files, perform batch operations, view file details, and import detected Windows programs.
- Input and display: configure per-program display settings, keyboard and mouse input, virtual controls, and game controllers.
- Backup and recovery: export and restore PRoot desktop containers, Wine environments, and Wine C drives.

releases.name: NHL Legacy 2027 - 1.0.3
releases.body:
## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.3

Выбранный в лаунчере язык RU/EN теперь используется на экране подготовки графики и в Android-настройках во время игры: меню Select, настройках кнопок, окне назначения и режиме перемещения кнопок. Лаунчер переключается сразу, внутриигровые экраны — при следующем запуске игры. Язык оригинального игрового интерфейса выбирается отдельно.

The launcher’s RU/EN choice now carries into graphics preparation and in-game Android controls: the Select menu, game settings, button mapping, and button-layout editor. The launcher updates immediately; in-game Android screens use the choice on the next game launch. The original game language remains separate.

Signed Android ARM64 APK, `versionCode 14`, same package and signing certificate as 1.0.2. Native libraries, game assets, and the ISO importer are unchanged byte for byte. The Y700 installed this version over 1.0.2 without deleting imported game files. Device checks confirmed the graphics-preparation screen and game settings in both EN and RU, the English button-mapping and layout screens, and both Select-menu languages. A match was not replayed for this text-only update.

releases.body:
## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.1

### Русский

- Первый публичный APK для Android ARM64 с лаунчером NHL Legacy 2027.
- Игровые файлы импортируются **только из ISO**. Проверяются 20 файлов по размеру и SHA-256; ZIP игровых данных больше не поддерживается. ZIP составов и драйверов остаются отдельными функциями.
- Два режима матча: 960 × 540 и 1280 × 720, интерфейс 1280 × 720. Доступны настройки полной арены, управления, системного или пользовательского Vulkan-драйвера и очистка графического кеша.
- При ошибке либо отмене импорта прежняя установка сохраняется. Успешное обновление сохраняет кеши и пользовательские данные.

Полный импорт ISO подтверждён пользователем на Lenovo Y700 (`TB321FU`, Android 15); все 20 файлов дополнительно проверены независимым чтением. Полное прохождение и совместимость со всеми GPU не подтверждены. Возможны просадки FPS и неверная поза вратаря в отдельных повторах.

Для игры требуется собственный оригинальный ISO NHL Legacy Edition. Образ и игровые данные здесь не распространяются. После импорта ISO может быть удалён с устройства, поскольку нужные файлы установлены в хранилище приложения.

releases.name: WinLite v1.4.0
releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

releases.body:
Title: v2.6 – Xbox 360 games through Xenia, Xbox and Xenia settings tabs
Repository description:
Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu (original Xbox emulator) with a console-style dashboard, Xbox 360 games through your own Xenia, one-click 60 FPS patches, upscaling filters, CPU/GPU boost with per-game settings, and tools for finding out why a game is slow. Not supported by the xemu project.
---
Release body (paste into the GitHub release):
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.6
Xbox 360 games, through your own Xenia. xemu does not emulate the Xbox 360, and this fork still doesn't include or change any 360 emulator. If you download Xenia or Xenia Canary yourself, the library can now list your 360 games and start them in it.
Turn on Show Xbox 360 games on the new Xenia tab and choose your `xenia.exe` / `xenia_canary.exe`. Your game folders are scanned for disc images (.iso), extracted games with a `default.xex`, .xex files, Games on Demand and Xbox Live Arcade packages.

releases.name: v2.5 – Tron Red theme, sphere emblem, holographic covers, DOA3 color fix, Linux AppImage
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.

What's new in v2.5

Tron Red. A third dashboard color next to Neon and Green, red with amber. It works on every dashboard style. Pick it under Settings > Dashboard theme or the Library menu.
Sphere and fins is the default dashboard, with an X emblem on the sphere. New installs start on Original Blades in the original green. The sphere, fins, web, orbs and bars take the theme color you choose (cyan for Neon, red and orange for Tron Red), and so does the emblem. If you already picked a style or theme, nothing changes for you.
Holo and Aurora dashboards. Two more styles. Holo is a hologram terminal, and now has a light-cycle fight in its arena: two cycles meet, one is wounded and breaks into cubes of light, the other runs on and a new pair appears.
Holographic covers. Settings > Home screen covers has a third choice, Holographic: cases float over a projector ring, bob and turn slowly, with scanlines, a sweep of light, an occasional glitch and a tint in your theme color.

releases.name: v2.4 – Faster library scanning, Clear library, version in the title bar
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.4
Version in the title bar. The window now reads "xemu Modern GUI v2.4 | xemu v0.8.139", so it's easy to tell which build you're running.
Faster library scanning. Games appear as soon as they're found instead of after the whole folder has been read, several disc images are read at once, and extracted game folders (any folder containing `default.xbe`) are no longer searched file by file. Recycle-bin and hidden folders are skipped.
Clear library. Library > Folders has a new "Clear library..." button. It empties the game list and forgets your game folders, individually added games and hidden games, so you can add them again from scratch. Your game files are never touched. Play time, favorites, custom names and per-game settings are kept.

1.4 GHz CPU option. Real hardware speed can pace to 733 MHz (stock) or 1.4 GHz (like a modded console), under Settings > Performance. Real hardware speed is off by default.

releases.name: v2.3 – Faster games, NFL Fever 2004 fix, Linux build, Performance and compatibility release: CPU boost, GPU boost, per-game settings with automatic safe mode, a fix that lets NFL Fever 2004 run, and a first Linux build
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Experimental, unofficial fork of xemu for trying out UI improvements. Not supported by the xemu project: please don't ask about it in xemu's Discord or GitHub.
What's new in v2.3
This release is about speed and game compatibility. The emulation changes are listed here so you know what touches the game itself.
CPU boost and GPU boost (Settings > General > Performance). CPU boost runs the game's SSE math on your PC's processor and trims work in the CPU emulation. GPU boost turns on faster paths in the graphics code, such as skipping textures a shader never reads. Turn either off if a game misbehaves. The ideas and some of the code come from Tovarichtch's xemu fork (branch `perf-experimental`).
Per-game settings and safe mode. Each game can have its own CPU boost, GPU boost and shader seeding, used the next time it starts (Settings > General > Performance > This game). If xemu closes unexpectedly while a boost was on, that game starts in safe mode the next time, with the boosts off, and tells you. "Leave safe mode" is in the same place.

releases.body:
# YukiHub v0.4.5 更新日志

> 本次更新聚焦：**四平台游玩状态同步 · Hikarinagi 快捷登录优化 · SD 卡目录授权 · 稳定性修复**

## ✨ 全新功能

- **同步游玩状态至四个平台**：现在可以把本地的游玩时长与进度，一键同步到 **NextMoe·未萌（鲲 Galgame）**、**VNDB**、**Bangumi** 与 **Hikarinagi**。四个平台的入口统一收进个人资料页的「同步游玩状态」折叠卡，点开后按平台逐项操作，状态一目了然。
- **Hikarinagi 快捷登录支持邮箱识别**：现在用 Hikarinagi 快捷登录时会一并读取邮箱，若该邮箱已在 YukiHub 注册过，**将直接登录并绑定到原账号**，与 NextMoe·未萌 的行为完全一致，不再另开新号、云同步数据也不会分裂。

## 🎨 体验优化

- **内置 Gal 工具箱常规维护**：同步更新内置工具箱里的网址与内容，保持可用。
- **同步进度弹窗重做**：进度展示改为环形进度 + 分步状态，四个平台的同步过程都能清楚看到当前在做什么。
- **新增取消绑定游玩状态同步凭证**:打开对应窗口后，长按即可弹出取消，清空凭证以重新登陆。
- **bangumi游戏自定义查询新增id查询**:因api缺陷，部分游戏不能直接搜到，因此新增了id搜索，在自定义搜索界面，直接输入数字is即可。

## 🛠 问题修复

- **修复 NextMoe 源封面模糊的问题**：部分作品封面会取到低分辨率图，现已修正取图逻辑。
- **修复通知权限疯狂弹窗的问题**：此前会反复请求通知权限，现已正常。
- **修复 SD 卡授权时选不到指定文件夹的问题**：内置文件选择器新增 SD 卡支持，现在可以正常选中 SD 卡里的游戏目录。

## 📌 说明

- **同步范围**：VNDB 不支持通过 API 写入游玩时长，因此同步到 VNDB 时只同步状态。
- **首次同步需要授权**：各平台同步需先在对应平台完成一次授权，之后会在后台自动使用。

releases.body:
### The gamepad and the touch stick

The face buttons of a controller are one choice now: by position (the Switch's
layout - X on top, Y on the left, A on the right, B at the bottom) or by what
the controller prints. It is set per controller in the gamepad center and takes
effect at once. The per-key rebinding is gone: it needed a capture flow and a
binding table, players got lost in it, and a rebound button took another key's
source away without anyone seeing why. The center's scope shows what the game
receives, so pressing a button is the test.

The controller's axes are read the way that controller reports them. The Xbox
family (a USB xpad, a Bluetooth XInput pad) puts its triggers on Z/RZ and its
right stick on RX/RY - the opposite of the usual layout - so those pads'
triggers never fired and their right stick never reached the game. The app now
works the roles out of the device's own ranges.

The touch stick starts where the thumb lands: the offset is taken from the
point the finger went down, so a thumb on the rim has output right away. A
small dead zone around that point, the rim is the full deflection, and the
right stick is finer at low speed.

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This build fixes the runtime build on the phone. If you have not imported the profiles package of v0.4.0-alpha01 yet, you still must: the app runs the games on the new host (0.4.0), and the old package's packs were built for the previous one. Import it in the environment check (the "manage" box).
- (中文) 本版修复了手机上的运行库构建。如果你还没有导入 v0.4.0-alpha01 的档案包，现在仍然必须导入：App 用新宿主(0.4.0)运行游戏，旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的。到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入。

## Fixed: the runtime a game needs on the phone builds again

The new host (0.4.0) checks every profile's picture - the screenshot the README shows - and looked for it in the app's own tool folder, where the pictures are not shipped: the build failed with "readme_image 'docs/images/...': no such file in the repository", and every game whose profile names a picture could not be rebuilt. The check now runs where the pictures are (a checkout of the repository), and the app's own copy leaves it out. Sixty games had a picture in their profile: all of them build now.

The fix is in the app, so the runtime on the phone is rebuilt as soon as the app is updated. Nothing to import for this one.

---

## 中文说明

### 修复:游戏在手机上需要的运行库又能构建了

## Before you update · 更新之前(必读)

- (EN) This release moves the packs onto a new host (0.4.0). After the app updates, you **must** import the new profiles package in the environment check (the "manage" box): the old package's packs were built for the previous host and will not work with this app. The app will remind you and point you there. Update the app first, then import the package - both steps are required.
- (中文) 本次更新更换了数据包运行的宿主(0.4.0)。更新 App 之后，**必须**到环境检查里(那个"管理"按钮)导入新的档案包:旧档案包的数据包是按旧宿主构建的，和新版 App 不匹配，无法正常使用。App 会主动提醒并指路。先更新 App，再导入档案包，两步都不能少。

## New games: NieR:Automata, Link's Awakening, Silver Pines

Three games join the profiles package:

- **NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition** - boots with update 1.0.3, and the map is drawn correctly after loading a save. Broader gameplay checks are still pending, so expect rough edges.
- **The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening** - playable on update 1.1.0, verified on a Lenovo TB323FU. It runs at a dynamic 30/60 fps by default; the stable-60 option stays off (it can judder on weaker chips). It needs the firmware files.
- **Silver Pines** - the v65536 update (1.0.1) plays, verified on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Android 16).

## Fixed: the failed ports

The separate profiles package had broken the ports: the patches of an
imported profile never reached the build, and the port failed - FINAL
FANTASY RESONANCE's allocator cut was missing, its Unreal allocator
reserved 38 GB of address space, and the port died. Fixed: the imported
profile reaches the rewriter now, in every port and every runtime
rebuild.

## New game: Catherine: Full Body

The Korean / Chinese v0 release of Catherine: Full Body is playable, at
a held 30 fps as on the Switch, verified on device. Import the profiles
package again after the update (the environment check's "manage" box),
or the game is not in your layer.

Also in the APK: a game that compiles its own shaders at boot can be
ported on the phone; anime intros no longer freeze and movies no longer
end on a black screen; the builds page says when your profiles package
is older than this build's.

---

## 中文说明

### 修复：移植失败

独立档案包导致移植失败：导入档案里的补丁没有进入构建（《最终幻想 共鸣》
缺了分配器裁剪，预留 38 GB 内存闪退）。已修复：导入的档案现在能正确送达
改写器，每次移植和运行库重建都会用到。

### 新游戏：凯瑟琳 Full Body

《凯瑟琳 Full Body》韩版/中文 v0 发售版可玩，稳定 30 帧（与 Switch 一致），
真机验证过。更新后请重新导入档案包（环境检查里的"管理"），否则手机上没有
这个游戏。

APK 里还有：开机自编着色器的游戏支持手机移植；动画开场不再定格、影片不再

## The app no longer carries the game profiles

The profiles are half a gigabyte of shader tables, and every release
copied them again. This build carries none of them. After the update,
import the profiles package once: Settings → the environment check, or the
profiles row's "manage" box, which can fetch this build's own package for
you (the download is digest-checked). The package is the release's second
file. It lives outside the app's own storage, so future updates never
touch it.

**Packs built with this version need this app to run** - the pack no
longer carries the runtime inside; the app keeps one runtime per game and
builds it when the game page opens. The games already on your phone keep
working.

### New
- The game page checks and rebuilds the game itself; a failure shows the
  reason with a retry. The "update runtime" chore is gone.
- Tapping a game resumes it or refuses it - no more wrongly greyed-out
  cards.
- Pin a game to the home screen from its detail panel; the shortcut opens
  through the launch gate and greys out when the game is deleted.
- A port can be exported as one folder and taken to another phone; the
  same game can be in the library twice.

# Oblivion for Android 0.1.3

APK: `Oblivion-0.1.3.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `e74c55c378825480eedb6b2c781946bc4bef3555`

## Fixed
- Mali GPUs: geometry no longer explodes into streaks on Mali GPUs (Exynos, Dimensity, Tensor, Kirin), which lack the clip-distance feature.

## Performance
- Each thread keeps its own cache of recently freed small blocks and reuses them without taking the global heap lock. In testing, an allocate-and-free went from about 34 ms to 5 ms. Freeing the same block twice is still detected and logged though.
- A thread that re-enters a lock it already holds now just counts up the way Windows does, instead of going through the real lock each time.
- Memory copies: the base memcpy routine, about 10% of all CPU, now runs as Android's native copy.
- The game reads the clock hundreds of thousands of times a second. QueryPerformanceCounter, GetTickCount and timeGetTime now read the processor's hardware timer instead of making a system call.
- A missing Data folder is now remembered after the first check - no repeated path search and log line each time.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Oblivion folder to any bug report.

releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.

## 1.0.3 社区发布

本版整合已测试的图形、声音和缓存优化，提供 Android ARM64 安装包与社区应用包。游戏数据由使用者自行准备，应用通过 ARM64 原生执行、HLE 服务桥接及 NVN → Vulkan 兼容层运行。

## 更新内容

- 请求低延迟音频输出，并处理设备拒绝请求时的回退。RG477M 同场景计入应用排队后的时间戳推算播放等待，旧模式约 215 毫秒，本版运行层两轮约 101、137 毫秒。
- 缓存原生模块的分配器导出位置，改进纹理描述符 ID 查找，缩小已证明写回范围的缓存维护。
- 失效描述符缓存的 CPU 元数据按每帧最多 512 项分批清理，清理安排在 GPU 提交和限帧等待之间。
- 保留可编辑虚拟手柄、掌机原生键位与游戏内存档功能。金手指功能计划后续加入。

## 机型与实测范围

- 全部设备采用底座模式，目标帧率为 30。高端高分辨率机型选择原生底座渲染档位，RG477M 使用 800×450 内部三维渲染档位。
- RG477M 的花叶位置测试了 2400 个真实移动帧间隔，实际显示约 29.20 帧，最长显示间隔约 99 毫秒。对照版本同点约 28.44 帧，最长约 116 毫秒。本版发布包的原生库与该次测量使用的原生库逐字节一致。
- 高通、天玑设备分档与厂商条件通过组件回归，包含荣耀 SM8635 / Adreno 735 配置。荣耀平板的本版安装与真实游戏回归等待用户重新连接 USB，其他机型需要逐机验证。
- 图形测试 94 项，93 项通过，1 项缺少私有输入而跳过。运行时 10 项、JNI 分档 4 项及 Java 机型分档合约通过。

## 已知限制

全场景稳定 30 帧尚未完成，复杂城镇、过图与长时间运行仍可能卡顿。对白口型及完整过场的物理音画同步仍待验证。正式发布版本号表示这一阶段的可下载构建，兼容范围以实测记录为准。

安装附件 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-arm64.apk`，或解压 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-community.zip` 获取应用、安装说明、版权说明及第三方许可证。准备同版本 v1.0.7 的 NSO、RomFS 与转换后的着色器，目录与权限操作见附件 `install-guide.zh-CN.md`。升级前请备份个人存档。

- **渲染调度与流水线优化**：优化间接绘制调度流程，精简不必要的 CPU 同步等待，保留精准的 GPU 资源生命周期检查，降低图形提交开销。
- **贴图解码与上传加速**：优化贴图解码上传缓冲机制，复用快路径以提升多线程块纹理解码效率。
- **掌机设备底座模式适配**：RG477M 默认启用原游戏底座模式与 800×450 内部 3D 渲染档位，内置多帧缓冲队列与原生显示时间戳支持，目标锁定 30 FPS。
- **操作与存档支持**：提供可编辑布局的虚拟手柄与物理手柄自动识别支持；游戏进度直接通过游戏原生存档系统保存。

---

## 📱 实测范围与已知限制

- **实测表现**：在 RG477M 上完成实测，常规与移动场景平均显示接近 30 FPS（约 29.8~29.9 FPS）。目前在场景初次加载、过图及部分复杂 3D 城镇场景中，偶发存在短暂掉帧与卡顿。
- **设备支持**：本版本已在 RG477M 上完成验证；荣耀平板及其他主流高通、天玑机型目前正在进行真机回归验证与适配。
- **已知限制**：当前属于预览测试阶段，尚未达到全场景稳定 30 FPS，相关性能与管线优化仍在持续推进中。

---

## 💬 资源数据包获取与交流群

- **数据包获取**：抖音搜索 ID：`Cetto`（或搜索：`樱木`），进入主页加入交流群。
- 群公告已置顶网盘一键下载链接（通用数据包 + 安装部署说明）。
- 欢迎在群内交流各机型实机运行反馈、按键映射体验与性能表现。

---

## 📦 安装与数据要求

1. 附件提供 ARM64 安装包（`.apk`）、完整社区包（`.zip`）及对应校验文件。
2. 运行必须配合 **《空之轨迹 the 1st》v1.0.7 原版游戏数据**（NSO 主程序、RomFS 及转换后的着色器需保持版本完全一致）。
3. 详细安装步骤与目录结构请参阅随包附件《安装说明》（`install-guide.zh-CN.md`）。

---

## ⚖️ 免责与版权声明

# 空轨原生兼容运行程序 1.0.1-preview

Android ARM64 社区流程验证版，包含兼容运行程序、项目自有界面资源、第三方许可与中文使用说明。游戏数据由使用者自行准备。

## 本版更新

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。
- Mali 默认使用原游戏 960×540 三维渲染档位，目标 30 帧。采用缓存读回和两项着色器等价整理，事件延迟发布和大缓冲写跟踪默认关闭。用户已确认这一配置天空无闪烁。
- 天玑 MT68/MT69 默认保留原游戏分配器空指针判断，避免地址位判断破坏分配器状态。
- 虚拟手柄参照同作者 FFRS 项目，支持显示切换、长按编辑、拖动布局、大小与透明度保存。保留原游戏存档。金手指计划后续加入。
- 桌面应用图标采用自有几何山形图案。版本号由本轮整理设为 1.0.1-preview，code 2。

## 实测与已知问题

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

当前复杂户外与城镇仍有明显掉帧，尚未达到稳定 30 帧。无闪烁配置的户外采样约 21～25 帧，复杂城镇约 10～20 帧，首次加载和过图仍可能停顿。曾接近 30 帧的事件延迟实验会出现天空条纹，因此发布配置关闭该实验。完整游戏流程与长时间稳定性仍待验证。

其他天玑机型仍待逐机实测。荣耀平板沿用原有设备分支，本轮按用户要求暂停荣耀真机回归。

## 下载和安装

直接安装 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-arm64.apk`。社区转发可使用 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-community.zip`，其中包含 APK、安装说明、版权与免责说明、完整第三方许可和构建清单。使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验下载内容。

应用包名 `org.snk.the1st.gamewindow`，arm64-v8a，当前为预览调试签名包。覆盖安装前请备份自己的原游戏存档，签名不匹配时先核实旧包来源。

使用者自行准备合法取得并完整合并的 v1.0.7 数据，目录内应包含四个 NSO、RomFS 与配套转换着色器。具体目录与按键操作见随包《安装与使用》。

## 版权与免责说明

## 1.0.3 社区发布

本版整合已测试的图形、声音和缓存优化，提供 Android ARM64 安装包与社区应用包。游戏数据由使用者自行准备，应用通过 ARM64 原生执行、HLE 服务桥接及 NVN → Vulkan 兼容层运行。

## 更新内容

- 请求低延迟音频输出，并处理设备拒绝请求时的回退。RG477M 同场景计入应用排队后的时间戳推算播放等待，旧模式约 215 毫秒，本版运行层两轮约 101、137 毫秒。
- 缓存原生模块的分配器导出位置，改进纹理描述符 ID 查找，缩小已证明写回范围的缓存维护。
- 失效描述符缓存的 CPU 元数据按每帧最多 512 项分批清理，清理安排在 GPU 提交和限帧等待之间。
- 保留可编辑虚拟手柄、掌机原生键位与游戏内存档功能。金手指功能计划后续加入。

## 机型与实测范围

- 全部设备采用底座模式，目标帧率为 30。高端高分辨率机型选择原生底座渲染档位，RG477M 使用 800×450 内部三维渲染档位。
- RG477M 的花叶位置测试了 2400 个真实移动帧间隔，实际显示约 29.20 帧，最长显示间隔约 99 毫秒。对照版本同点约 28.44 帧，最长约 116 毫秒。本版发布包的原生库与该次测量使用的原生库逐字节一致。
- 高通、天玑设备分档与厂商条件通过组件回归，包含荣耀 SM8635 / Adreno 735 配置。荣耀平板的本版安装与真实游戏回归等待用户重新连接 USB，其他机型需要逐机验证。
- 图形测试 94 项，93 项通过，1 项缺少私有输入而跳过。运行时 10 项、JNI 分档 4 项及 Java 机型分档合约通过。

## 已知限制

全场景稳定 30 帧尚未完成，复杂城镇、过图与长时间运行仍可能卡顿。对白口型及完整过场的物理音画同步仍待验证。正式发布版本号表示这一阶段的可下载构建，兼容范围以实测记录为准。

## 安装与校验

安装附件 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-arm64.apk`，或解压 `snk-the1st-1.0.3-community.zip` 获取应用、安装说明、版权说明及第三方许可证。准备同版本 v1.0.7 的 NSO、RomFS 与转换后的着色器，目录与权限操作见附件 `install-guide.zh-CN.md`。升级前请备份个人存档。

附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 与 `release-manifest.json` 提供完整性及来源记录。

## 交流群与资源说明

抖音搜索 ID `Cetto`（或搜索 `樱木`），进入主页加入交流群。群公告提供部署说明与资源配置指引。使用者应确保自行提供的数据具有相应使用权，并支持正版游戏。
